scene.speaker: maya
scene.bubble: Kili has to deliver a letter to the new museum — let's give him directions from the sky!
scene.intro: Kili has to deliver a letter to the new museum, and he has never been there. Go straight on to the end of this street, says Maya, then turn left at the bank, go past the bakery, along the river and over the old bridge. The museum is on your right. Kili flies over everything in ninety seconds, which is cheating. Can YOU give directions to a stranger? Try it!

data.script: Maya: Okay Kili, fly straight on along the main street. … Maya: Now turn left at the clock tower. … Maya: Do you see the market? Go past it — don't stop for food! … Maya: Now fly over the old stone bridge. … Maya: Go through the city park, between the tall trees. … Maya: The museum is opposite the fountain — the building with the red roof. … Maya: Perfect landing! Give the letter to the manager. Mission complete!

data.text: Student A closes their eyes. Student B guides them through the classroom with directions (slowly and safely!): "Three steps straight on… turn left…" Goal: reach the door. Then swap.

activities.title: A and B are not the same. Find out why!
activities.instructions: Look at picture A and picture B. Find the 12 differences and tell your partner about them.

data.script: Look at the picture. Listen and write the names. There is one example. … Diego: Who is that in the funfair? The girl in the green shirt with a magnifying glass. … Maya: That is Maya. Maya is looking at something very small. … Diego: And who is the big black bird with a white collar? … Maya: That is Kili. Look, Kili is carrying a letter. … Diego: And who is the girl with black plaits and a purple shirt? … Maya: That is Lia. Look, Lia is jumping with a skipping rope. … Diego: And who is the boy with short fair hair and a rucksack? … Maya: That is Samu. Look, Samu is waving. … Diego: And who is the girl with fair hair and a dark blue jacket? … Maya: That is Ingrid. Look, Ingrid is reading the plan for the day.
data.voice_note: Voces: Diego (nino, reportero) pregunta y Maya (nina, cientifica) responde.
